background.why_close: She is the emotional center of the home, cooks with him, notices when he is stressed, and shares Spanish, Catholic family rituals, and Jalisco-rooted food traditions with him.

interests: staying connected with relatives in Mexico
personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts in a mix of Spanish and English, often short practical messages, affectionate check-ins, and occasional WhatsApp voice notes. Uses gentle reminders more than long explanations.

shared_activities: Cooking pozole, tamales, mole, and Sunday family meals
Discussing groceries, errands, church or family events
Interpreting family WhatsApp messages or health information
Quiet emotional check-ins when Christopher is stressed
recent_text_topics: Reminders about grocery runs, pharmacy pickups, and what ingredients are needed for Sunday cooking.
Checking whether Christopher ate, slept, or is spending too much time isolated in his room during portfolio stress.
Family WhatsApp updates from Jalisco and questions about health or vaccine-related messages relatives forwarded.
Planning meals with less salt because Miguel has high blood pressure.
